properties.name: camel.dataformat.toon.content-type-header
properties.description: Whether the data format should set the Content-Type header to text/toon when marshalling.

properties.name: camel.dataformat.toon.delimiter
properties.description: Delimiter used for tabular array rows and inline primitive arrays.

properties.name: camel.dataformat.toon.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable auto configuration of the toon data format. This is enabled by default.

properties.name: camel.dataformat.toon.indent
properties.description: Number of spaces per indentation level.

properties.name: camel.dataformat.toon.length-marker
properties.description: Whether to prefix array lengths with a hash marker so arrays render as hash-prefixed lengths instead of plain lengths.

properties.name: camel.dataformat.toon.strict
properties.description: Whether to enable strict validation when unmarshalling TOON. When false, JToon uses best-effort parsing.
